query: SELECT c.customer_id, c.segment_code, SUM(a.balance) AS total_balance FROM cos.retail_ods.account a JOIN cos.retail_ods.customer c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE a.dt = DATE '2026-10-01' AND a.status = 'OPEN' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.segment_code

SELECT c.customer_id, c.segment_code, SUM(a.balance) AS total_balance FROM cos.retail_ods.account a JOIN cos.retail_ods.customer c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE a.dt = DATE '2026-10-02' AND a.status = 'OPEN' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.segment_code

SELECT c.customer_id, c.segment_code, SUM(a.balance) AS total_balance FROM cos.retail_ods.account a JOIN cos.retail_ods.customer c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE a.dt = DATE '2026-10-03' AND a.status = 'OPEN' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.segment_code

SELECT c.customer_id, c.segment_code, SUM(a.balance) AS total_balance FROM cos.retail_ods.account a JOIN cos.retail_ods.customer c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE a.dt = DATE '2026-10-04' AND a.status = 'OPEN' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.segment_code

SELECT c.customer_id, c.segment_code, SUM(a.balance) AS total_balance FROM cos.retail_ods.account a JOIN cos.retail_ods.customer c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE a.dt = DATE '2026-10-05' AND a.status = 'OPEN' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.segment_code
SELECT t.txn_id, t.amount, t.channel FROM cos.retail_ods.transaction t WHERE t.account_id = 9001234567 AND t.txn_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' ORDER BY t.txn_ts DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT channel, count(*) AS n, sum(amount) AS total FROM cos.retail_ods.transaction WHERE dt >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND txn_type = 'DEBIT' AND channel IN ('ATM', 'POS', 'MOBILE') GROUP BY channel ORDER BY 2 DESC
SELECT channel, count(*) AS n, sum(amount) AS total FROM cos.retail_ods.transaction WHERE dt >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND txn_type = 'DEBIT' AND channel IN ('ATM', 'POS') GROUP BY channel ORDER BY 2 DESC
select customer_id, customer_name from customer where mobile_phone = '+33612345678'

WITH latest AS (SELECT customer_id, max(score_date) AS score_date FROM cos.risk_dm.customer_risk_score GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT s.customer_id, s.pd_score, s.rating FROM cos.risk_dm.customer_risk_score s JOIN latest l ON s.customer_id = l.customer_id AND s.score_date = l.score_date WHERE s.pd_score > 0.05

SELECT e.customer_id, e.exposure_amount, b.total_balance FROM cos.risk_dm.daily_exposure e LEFT JOIN cos.retail_dm.customer_daily_balance b ON e.customer_id = b.customer_id AND e.as_of_date = b.as_of_date WHERE e.as_of_date = DATE '2026-10-01' AND e.exposure_amount > 1000000

SELECT e.customer_id, e.exposure_amount, b.total_balance FROM cos.risk_dm.daily_exposure e LEFT JOIN cos.retail_dm.customer_daily_balance b ON e.customer_id = b.customer_id AND e.as_of_date = b.as_of_date WHERE e.as_of_date = DATE '2026-10-08' AND e.exposure_amount > 500000

SELECT cd.card_type, date_trunc('month', ct.txn_ts) AS m, sum(ct.amount) AS spend FROM cos.cards_ods.card_transaction ct JOIN cos.cards_ods.card cd ON ct.card_id = cd.card_id WHERE ct.dt BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' AND ct.mcc NOT IN ('6011', '6012') GROUP BY 1, 2

SELECT a.customer_id, count(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS cards FROM cos.cards_ods.card cd JOIN cos.retail_ods.account a ON cd.account_id = a.account_id WHERE cd.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY a.customer_id HAVING count(DISTINCT cd.card_id) > 2
SELECT merchant_name, sum(amount) FROM cos.cards_ods.card_transaction WHERE dt = DATE '2026-10-07' AND merchant_name LIKE 'AMAZ%' GROUP BY merchant_name

SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, b.branch_name, b.region FROM cos.retail_ods.customer c JOIN cos.ref.branch b ON c.branch_id = b.branch_id WHERE b.region = 'NORTH' AND c.open_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
SELECT p.category, count(*) FROM cos.retail_ods.account a JOIN cos.ref.product p ON a.product_code = p.product_code WHERE a.dt = DATE '2026-10-08' GROUP BY p.category
SELECT * FROM cos.retail_dm.v_active_customer WHERE segment_code = 'PRIVATE' AND total_balance > 250000.50
SELECT c.customer_id, t.tag FROM cos.retail_ods.customer c CROSS JOIN UNNEST(ARRAY['vip', 'new']) AS t (tag) WHERE c.segment_code = 'PRIVATE'

SELECT account_id, txn_date, amount, sum(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY txn_ts ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running FROM cos.retail_ods.transaction WHERE dt = DATE '2026-10-10' AND account_id IN (9001234567, 9001234568, 9001234569)
SELECT * FROM cos.retail_ods.transaction WHERE dt = DATE '2026-10-01' AND amount > 99999
SELEC customer_id FORM customer WHEER x = 'oops'
SHOW TABLES FROM cos.retail_ods
EXPLAIN SELECT * FROM cos.retail_ods.customer
CREATE TABLE cos.risk_dm.tmp_scores_20261011 AS SELECT customer_id, pd_score FROM cos.risk_dm.customer_risk_score WHERE score_date = DATE '2026-10-11'
